title: Connections · {name}
peerHelp: Address of the directly connected peer (a trusted proxy); the source is the real visitor address it forwarded
closeConfirm: Close this connection? The visitor will see it drop
truncated: Showing the {shown} longest-running of {matched}; search by IP to narrow down
historyHelp: History keeps only connections that lasted at least 1 second or were closed manually, the latest 200 per site, cleared on restart; see the access log for short requests.
help: Lists requests in progress (including long-lived ones such as WebSocket). Closing one ends the whole connection on HTTP/1.x; on HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 only that request is reset and other requests on the same connection continue. The visitor can reconnect right away; use Close and ban to keep them out.
banDesc: Ban {ip} and close its active connections on all sites.
banIpv6: IPv6 addresses are banned by their /64 range.
